   - Time spent in the next hour: 1 hour

   - Remaining distance = 12 miles - 6 miles = 6 miles

   - Total time available = 2 hours (already spent) + 1.5 hours (required for remaining distance) = 3.5 hours

   - Speed required = Remaining distance / Total time available
   - Speed required = 6 miles / 3.5 hours

\[ \text{Speed required} = \frac{6 \text{ miles}}{3.5 \text{ hours}} \]

\[ \text{Speed required} = \frac{6}{3.5} \text{ miles per hour} \]

\[ \text{Speed required} = \frac{60}{35} \text{ miles per hour} \]

\[ \text{Speed required} = \frac{12}{7} \text{ miles per hour} \]
